articles.summary: This summer, ~120 West Virginia high schoolers built roughly 80 real mobile apps using Thunkable through an AI education pilot backed by The Rockefeller Foundation and the state. The program drove hands-on AI/entrepreneurship learning, with 44% of participants reporting increased interest in starting their own businesses.
articles.title: West Virginia Students Build Real Apps With Thunkable

articles.summary: Thunkable is attending Futures Summit 2026 ("Human Skills in an Autonomous World") on September 9–10 at the Santa Clara Convention Center, joining 1,000+ educators and innovators. The team is excited to discuss AI/emerging tech in education, human skills alongside technical fluency, and preparing students for the workforce. Attendees can visit Thunkable's booth or book a live demo to build an app in three minutes.
articles.title: Thunkable Is Heading to Futures Summit 2026
